checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Lower arm supports the head while upper hand rests at the hip.
checks.feet: Side lying torso stays stable while only the upper leg abducts and lowers.
checks.movement: Lie on side with straight legs, lower arm supporting head and upper hand on hip. Keep hips stacked, raise upper leg without rotating knee or foot and lower slowly; repeat on opposite side after set. One side shown, 3.5 seconds raise, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
